messages.content:
<document id=DOC_posting_ten_five>
Mandatory requirements.
1. Python.
2. SQL.
3. Linux administration.
4. Git.
5. REST API design.
6. Unit testing.
7. CI pipelines.
8. Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm.
9. Kafka.
10. GraphQL.

Nice to have.
11. Grafana.
12. Prometheus.
13. Technical writing.
14. Mentoring.
15. Public speaking.
</document>

<document id=DOC_resume_at_floor>
Languages: Python, SQL.
Platform: Linux administration, Git.
Services: REST API design, unit testing, CI pipelines.
Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible.
Observability: Grafana, Prometheus.
Other: technical writing, mentoring, public speaking.
</document>

Assess the candidate against the posting below. A numbered requirement that
lists several items counts as one requirement, credited in proportion to how
many of those items the candidate shows. Report the mandatory match
percentage. If it lands between 78 and 84 percent, also report the combined
figure over all requirements and proceed only if that reaches 85 percent.

response.text:
**Mandatory match: 78%.** Combined match: **85.3%** (12.8/15), which meets the 85% bar, so the assessment proceeds.

| # | Requirement | Credit |
|---|-------------|--------|
| 1 | Python | 1/1 |
| 2 | SQL | 1/1 |
| 3 | Linux administration | 1/1 |
| 4 | Git | 1/1 |
| 5 | REST API design | 1/1 |
| 6 | Unit testing | 1/1 |
| 7 | CI pipelines | 1/1 |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | 4/5 (Helm missing) |
| 9 | Kafka | 0 |
| 10 | GraphQL | 0 |
| 11–15 | Grafana, Prometheus, technical writing, mentoring, public speaking | 5/5 |

Mandatory total is 7.8/10 = **78%**. Gaps are Kafka, GraphQL, and Helm (one of five items on requirement 8). All five nice-to-haves are present, so the combined score is 12.8/15 ≈ **85.3%**.
